title: Cross-platform rayx-signalr with Aspire-orchestrated end-to-end testing on every target

checks.descriptionMarkdown: New `Orchestration` and `Toolchain` categories: AppHost resources healthy/completed on dynamic ports; pinned wasm-bindgen resolution and provisioning.
New `Catalog` category: selection parsing (empty selection fails), cell generation, and catalog consistency against `e2e --list` and `playwright test --list`.

Migrated native scenarios as black-box `e2e` tests through the Aspire runner. Selection: targets `native`, scenarios `ordinary-reconnect,stateful-reconnect,stream-cancellation`, JSON and MessagePack (6 cells).

Migrated browser scenarios in Chromium against `fixture-host` through the Aspire runner. Selection: targets `chromium`, scenarios `ordinary-reconnect,stateful-reconnect,short-stream-chaining,stream-cancellation`, JSON and MessagePack (8 cells).

New `Repository`, `WorkflowContract` and `DependencySecurity` categories replacing `scripts/ci/verify-workflows.ps1` (no scripts or removed hooks, workflow governance and Aspire usage, `cargo audit` and NuGet vulnerability scan).

New functional scenarios as native cells. Selection: targets `native`, scenarios `connect-negotiate,authentication,invoke,send,server-stream,callbacks,concurrency-and-clones,large-payload,server-close,reconnect-exhaustion`, JSON and MessagePack (20 cells).

New functional scenarios in Chromium. Selection: targets `chromium`, scenarios `connect-negotiate,authentication,invoke,send,server-stream,callbacks,concurrency-and-clones,large-payload,server-close,reconnect-exhaustion`, JSON and MessagePack (20 cells).
New `Platform` case `manifest-hygiene` (normal graphs, crate type, tokio features).
New `Platform` case `wasi-rejected` (`wasm32-wasip1` build fails with the browser-only message).
New `tls_configuration` unit tests (precedence, `use_webpki_roots`, PEM errors before I/O, Android extra-root verifier selection).
`tls_configuration` tests without TLS features: secure endpoints return the explicit 'TLS support is disabled' error.
New `tls` scenario against the AppHost HTTPS fixture endpoint. Selection: targets `native,chromium`, scenarios `tls`, JSON and MessagePack (4 cells).

R4.C6's own proof: the functional native cells rerun because the hyper negotiate client replaces the HTTP path of every connection. Selection: targets `native`, scenarios `connect-negotiate,authentication,invoke,send,server-stream,callbacks,concurrency-and-clones,large-payload,server-close,reconnect-exhaustion`, JSON and MessagePack (20 cells).
New `Platform` cases `tls-graph` (per-target `cargo tree`) and `android-build` (`cargo ndk` checks, default and webpki feature sets, Android re-export).
New `negotiation_` unit tests through an injected request function.
New `skip_negotiation` unit tests.
New `negotiate-redirect` and `skip-negotiation` scenarios. Selection: targets `native,chromium`, scenarios `negotiate-redirect,skip-negotiation`, JSON and MessagePack (8 cells).
New `runtime_ownership` unit tests (no runtime â†’ explanatory error, configured handle preferred).
New `executor-independence` scenario driven from a non-Tokio thread. Selection: targets `native`, scenarios `executor-independence`, JSON and MessagePack (2 cells).

R6.C3's own proof: the runtime-owned writer/receiver tasks carry every native operation, so the functional and migrated native cells rerun. Selection: targets `native`, scenarios `connect-negotiate,authentication,invoke,send,server-stream,callbacks,concurrency-and-clones,large-payload,server-close,reconnect-exhaustion,ordinary-reconnect,stateful-reconnect,stream-cancellation`, JSON and MessagePack (26 cells).
New `Platform` case `wasm-transport` (no `setInterval`/`forget`, browser graph without wasm-sockets/wasm-timer/async-std/ehttp).
New `message-burst` scenario. Selection: targets `chromium`, scenarios `message-burst`, JSON and MessagePack (2 cells).

R7.C6's own proof: the transport is replaced underneath every browser scenario, so the functional and migrated Chromium cells rerun. Selection: targets `chromium`, scenarios `connect-negotiate,authentication,invoke,send,server-stream,callbacks,concurrency-and-clones,large-payload,server-close,reconnect-exhaustion,ordinary-reconnect,stateful-reconnect,short-stream-chaining,stream-cancellation`, JSON and MessagePack (28 cells).
New `worker-transport` scenario in a dedicated module worker. Selection: targets `chromium`, scenarios `worker-transport`, JSON and MessagePack (2 cells).
New `Platform` case `threaded-wasm-build` (nightly build-std atomics with RayX's flags, default and all features).
New `threaded-wasm` scenario on the cross-origin-isolated threaded fixture. Selection: targets `chromium`, scenarios `threaded-wasm`, JSON and MessagePack (2 cells).
New `liveness_` unit tests (scheduler with deterministic clock, configuration validation, handshake parsing, Ping encoding and classification).
New native liveness scenarios. Selection: targets `native`, scenarios `keepalive-idle,server-timeout,handshake-timeout`, JSON and MessagePack (6 cells).
New browser liveness scenarios. Selection: targets `chromium`, scenarios `keepalive-idle,server-timeout,handshake-timeout`, JSON and MessagePack (6 cells).
New `lifecycle_controls` unit tests (Paused transitions, no-op/terminal rules, stale generations, status mapping, `DefaultRetryPolicy`).
New native pause/resume scenarios. Selection: targets `native`, scenarios `pause-resume,pause-resume-stateful`, JSON and MessagePack (4 cells).
New browser pause/resume scenarios. Selection: targets `chromium`, scenarios `pause-resume,pause-resume-stateful`, JSON and MessagePack (4 cells).

New Firefox and WebKit targets running the whole browser catalog (minimum allows the documented `threaded-wasm` exclusion on one engine). Selection: targets `firefox,webkit`, scenarios `all`, JSON and MessagePack (96 cells).

New Android target running every native-capable scenario on a running x86_64 emulator (prerequisite: start AVD `Pixel_9_Pro_XL` or set `RAYX_SIGNALR_E2E_ANDROID_SERIAL`). Selection: targets `android`, scenarios `all`, JSON and MessagePack (46 cells).
`WorkflowContract` category extended to every target job, the Android emulator runner, the iOS simulator job and the platform quality jobs.

New `pending_failure_completion` unit group: failing or disposing pending work completes awaiting invocations with an error and ends streams.
New `functional_baseline` unit groups: void completions (JSON/MessagePack), stream error completions, terminal remote close in the reconnect coordinator.

New `stateful_transport_generation` unit group: a writer of a lost transport cannot track frames; the resumed transport continues the sequence.

sprints.title: Aspire test orchestration replaces every test script

tasks.title: Solution, AppHost, fixture host and pinned wasm-bindgen
tasks.descriptionMarkdown: Add `RayX.SignalR.slnx`, `global.json`, `aspire.config.json`, `Directory.Build.props`; create `dotnet/RayX.SignalR.AppHost` (service with dynamic HTTP endpoint and `/health`, completion-gated pinned wasm-bindgen provisioning, fixture build and bindgen executables, `fixture-host`), `dotnet/RayX.SignalR.FixtureHost`, and the `dotnet/RayX.SignalR.E2E.Tests` skeleton with the `Orchestration` and `Toolchain` categories; make `SignalRTestService` port-agnostic.

tasks.title: Scenario catalog and cell runners
tasks.descriptionMarkdown: Add the `AspireEnvironment` collection fixture, `ScenarioCatalog`, `E2ECells` selection from `RAYX_SIGNALR_E2E_*`, the native runner (prebuilt `e2e` binary, exact test, 60 s bound, process-tree kill), the browser runner (Playwright CLI per engine and exact title), redacted failure diagnostics with resource logs, and the `Catalog` category including catalog consistency.

tasks.title: Migrate existing scenarios to black-box end-to-end tests
tasks.descriptionMarkdown: Create the `e2e` integration-test target (`test = false`) with `ordinary_reconnect`, `stateful_reconnect` and `stream_cancellation` (`json`/`messagepack`) using only the public API and server-side transport abort; parameterize the fixture and Playwright specs by environment/page configuration and drop `webServer`; delete `src/tests/tests_tokio.rs`, `src/tests/tests_msgpack.rs` and the production test hooks in `client_tokio.rs`.

tasks.title: Remove scripts, add contract categories, run CI through Aspire
tasks.descriptionMarkdown: Delete `scripts/` and `tools-node/scripts/`; add the `Repository`, `WorkflowContract` and `DependencySecurity` categories carrying every former `verify-workflows.ps1` assertion; replace `interop.yml` with `e2e.yml` (native on ubuntu/windows/macos, Chromium on ubuntu, Aspire CLI install, pinned-tool cache, failure-only artifacts) and update `quality.yml` to call the categories; rewrite README's validation section for `aspire run`/`dotnet test`.

tasks.title: Fail pending work instead of abandoning it on transport replacement
tasks.descriptionMarkdown: Finding from the migrated black-box `ordinary-reconnect` scenario: an invocation pending while the server aborted the transport never completed, because `fail_pending` dropped the action and `ManualFutureCompleter::cancel` left its awaiter `Pending` forever (the removed in-crate hook bypassed this path). Pending invocations now complete with the failure message on `fail_pending` (both targets) and with an explicit error when their action is disposed; pending streams end. Covered by the new `pending_failure_completion` unit group and the native `ordinary-reconnect` cells.

tasks.title: Test-service functional fixtures
tasks.descriptionMarkdown: Add the D4 functional fixtures to `SignalRTestService`: `/test-auth` with the test authentication scheme and identity probe, void/throwing/recorded-send/throwing-stream methods with probes, detailed errors, large-message route limits, server-close methods, `OnDisconnected` counter, hub-rejection control and per-cell reset endpoint.

tasks.title: Native functional scenarios
tasks.descriptionMarkdown: Add the ten functional scenarios to `tests/e2e` (`connect_negotiate`, `authentication`, `invoke`, `send`, `server_stream`, `callbacks`, `concurrency_and_clones`, `large_payload`, `server_close`, `reconnect_exhaustion`) for JSON and MessagePack and register them in the catalog for every target (native-capable).

tasks.title: Browser functional scenarios
tasks.descriptionMarkdown: Add fixture exports and `tools-node/tests/signalr-functional.spec.ts` for the same ten scenarios (browser credentials through the negotiate header and WebSocket `access_token`).

sprints.title: Manifest hygiene and browser-only WASM gating

tasks.title: Dependency and crate-type hygiene
tasks.descriptionMarkdown: Move test/debug crates to dev-dependencies, delete `wasm-timer`, `async-std` and `src/tests/tests_wasm.rs`, make the library `rlib`, trim `tokio` features, and add the `Platform` case `manifest-hygiene`.

tasks.title: Browser-only wasm gating
tasks.descriptionMarkdown: Unify the native/browser `cfg` predicates (`src/client/context.rs`), add the `compile_error!` guard for non-`unknown` wasm32 targets (narrowing browser-only dependencies if needed), and add the `Platform` case `wasi-rejected`.

tasks.title: TLS configuration module, features and API
tasks.descriptionMarkdown: Add `src/communication/tls.rs`, the `tls-*` features and defaults, native-only `with_additional_root_certificates_pem` and `use_webpki_roots`, the Android re-export module, and the `tls_configuration` tests (also under `--no-default-features`).

tasks.title: AppHost TLS fixture and `tls` scenario
tasks.descriptionMarkdown: Generate the ephemeral CA and leaf in the AppHost, add the service's HTTPS endpoint, pass the CA to cells, and add the `tls` scenario for native (`tests/e2e/tls.rs`) and Chromium (`ignoreHTTPSErrors`) plus its catalog entry.

tasks.title: Native rustls WebSocket and hyper negotiate
tasks.descriptionMarkdown: Switch `connect_socket` to `Connector::Rustls` with the connection's config, replace native `ehttp` negotiate with the hyper HTTP/1.1 client over the same config, make `ehttp` browser-only and remove `tokio-native-tls`.

tasks.title: Mobile dependency graph and Android build cases
tasks.descriptionMarkdown: Add the `Platform` cases `tls-graph` and `android-build` and fix any graph or Android compile issue they reveal.

tasks.title: Negotiation model and redirect loop
tasks.descriptionMarkdown: Add `src/communication/negotiation.rs` (`NegotiateOutcome`, `negotiate_with` over an injected request function, redirect limit, token propagation, error surfacing), wire the native and browser request functions, keep reconnect/resume endpoint rules, and add the `negotiation_` tests.

tasks.title: Skip negotiation
tasks.descriptionMarkdown: Add `skip_negotiation()`, direct `ConnectionData` construction with `access_token`, the stateful-incompatibility error, direct ordinary reconnect on both targets, and the `skip_negotiation` tests.

tasks.title: Redirect and skip-negotiation end-to-end
tasks.descriptionMarkdown: Add the redirect endpoint, `AccessTokenProbe` and negotiate counter to the test service and the `negotiate-redirect` and `skip-negotiation` scenarios for native and Chromium.

tasks.title: Runtime handle capture and configuration
tasks.descriptionMarkdown: Add native-only `with_runtime_handle`, resolve the handle at `connect`, return the explanatory error before negotiation when none exists, and add the `runtime_ownership` tests.

tasks.title: Runtime-owned tasks and executor-agnostic futures
tasks.descriptionMarkdown: Run connect/reconnect I/O on the stored handle, add the writer task and command channel (stateful tracking inside it), move reconnect loops and dropped-stream cancellation onto the handle, make `disconnect` non-blocking, document `InvocationContext::spawn`, and add the native-only `executor-independence` scenario.

sprints.title: Event-driven browser transport, workers and threaded WASM

tasks.title: gloo-net transport, cancellable timers and fetch negotiate
tasks.descriptionMarkdown: Rewrite `src/communication/client_wasm.rs` on `gloo-net` WebSocket streams with one receiver task per socket, `gloo-timers` sleeps and `gloo-net` fetch negotiate; remove `wasm-sockets` and `ehttp`; add the `Platform` case `wasm-transport` and the `message-burst` scenario.

tasks.title: Web Worker support
tasks.descriptionMarkdown: Make the fixture start-up worker-safe, add the module-worker host page served by `fixture-host`, the `worker-transport` scenario and catalog entry, and document single-owner `!Send` use.

tasks.title: Threaded WASM build and runtime proof
tasks.descriptionMarkdown: Add the `Platform` case `threaded-wasm-build`, the AppHost threaded fixture build (`Fixture:Threads`, pinned nightly, RayX flags), the `fixture-host` `isolated` endpoint with COOP/COEP, and the `threaded-wasm` scenario asserting cross-origin isolation.

tasks.title: Liveness configuration, scheduler and handshake parsing
tasks.descriptionMarkdown: Add the three duration options with validation, `src/communication/liveness.rs`, protocol-aware Ping encoding, the shared handshake parser, and the `liveness_` tests.

tasks.title: Native liveness and service liveness fixtures
tasks.descriptionMarkdown: Drive Pings from the writer and server-timeout detection from the receiver, bound and validate the native handshake, add `KeepAliveHub`, `SilentHub` and `/silent-handshake`, and the three native scenarios with catalog entries.

tasks.title: Browser liveness
tasks.descriptionMarkdown: Add the per-socket liveness task and the bounded/validated browser handshake, plus fixture exports and Playwright tests for the three scenarios.

tasks.title: Paused lifecycle, status and DefaultRetryPolicy
tasks.descriptionMarkdown: Extend both lifecycle coordinators with `Paused`, add public `ConnectionStatus` and `SignalRClient::status()`, add `DefaultRetryPolicy`, and the `lifecycle_controls` tests.

tasks.title: Native pause and resume
tasks.descriptionMarkdown: Implement native `pause`/`resume` on the runtime handle and add the `pause-resume` and `pause-resume-stateful` scenarios with catalog entries.

tasks.title: Browser pause and resume
tasks.descriptionMarkdown: Implement browser `pause`/`resume`, fixture exports and Playwright tests for both scenarios.

sprints.title: Every target in CI, and consumer documentation

tasks.title: Firefox and WebKit targets
tasks.descriptionMarkdown: Add Playwright `firefox` and `webkit` projects and runner targets; fix engine-specific failures; record any documented engine limitation as a catalog exclusion with its reason.

tasks.title: Android emulator target
tasks.descriptionMarkdown: Add the Android runner (`cargo ndk` build, `adb` push/run, `10.0.2.2` endpoint rewrite, base64 CA, bounds, logcat diagnostics) and make every native-capable scenario pass on the x86_64 emulator.

tasks.title: iOS simulator target
tasks.descriptionMarkdown: Add the iOS simulator runner (`aarch64-apple-ios-sim` build, `xcrun simctl` boot/spawn, `SIMCTL_CHILD_*` environment, bounds, diagnostics); it is proven by the CI `e2e / ios` job.

tasks.title: All-target CI matrix
tasks.descriptionMarkdown: Add the Firefox/WebKit, Android-emulator and iOS-simulator e2e jobs and the Android/iOS/threaded-WASM/Platform quality jobs, extend the `WorkflowContract` category, push the epic branch and record a green run (R10.C3 and R10.C5 evidence) in the sprint review.

tasks.title: Consumer and contributor documentation
tasks.descriptionMarkdown: Write README's 'Platform support' and 'Testing with Aspire' sections, update `FORK.md` and the RayX.SignalR skill, and document the RayX.GameX conformance-gate replacement command.
